properties.description:
This rule detects potential process injection technique known as process doppelgänging, where adversaries may inject malicious code into process
order to evade process-based defenses as well as possibly elevate privileges. 
Process doppelgänging is a method of executing arbitrary code in the address space of a separate live process.   RITM1397976
properties.query:
let TriggeredUsers =
    SecurityAlert
    | where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-139 Potential Process Doppelganging"
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
    | extend A = parse_json(Entities)
    | mvexpand A
    | extend User = A.Name
    | where isnotempty(User)
    | summarize make_list(User);
let RollbackEvents = SecurityEvent1 // Step 1: NTFS rollback events
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
    | where EventID == 4985 // NTFS transaction state changed (rollback)
    | where Account !in (TriggeredUsers)
    | where not (
                ((ProcessName has_any ("TiWorker.exe", "poqexec.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe")
        or ParentProcessName has_any ("TiWorker.exe", "poqexec.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe")))
        and CommandLine contains "WinSxS"
            )
    | project
        RollbackTime = TimeGenerated,
        Initiator = Account,
        InitiatorType = AccountType,
        TargetHost = Computer,
        RollbackProcessName = Process,
        RollbackProcessPath = ProcessName,
        EventID;
let ProcessCreation = SecurityEvent1 // Step 2: Suspicious process creation
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine has_any ("TxF", "Rollback", "Transaction")
    | where Account !in (TriggeredUsers)
    | where not (
                ((NewProcessName has_any ("TiWorker.exe", "poqexec.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe")
        or ParentProcessName has_any ("TiWorker.exe", "poqexec.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe")))
        and CommandLine contains "WinSxS"
            )
    | project
        ProcCreateTime = TimeGenerated,
        Initiator = Account,
        InitiatorType = AccountType,
        TargetHost = Computer,
        SuspiciousProcessName = NewProcessName,
        SuspiciousCommandLine = CommandLine,
        ParentProcessName,
        EventID;
let TxFCalls = SecurityEvent1 // Step 3: TxF API calls (object access)
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
    | where EventID in (4656, 4663)
    | where ObjectName has_any ("TxF", "Transaction")
    | summarize TxFCallCount = count() by Account, Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m);
RollbackEvents // Step 4: Correlate rollback + process creation + TxF API usage
| join kind=inner (ProcessCreation) on Initiator, TargetHost
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', RollbackTime, ProcCreateTime)) <= 30
| join kind=inner (TxFCalls) on $left.Initiator == $right.Account and $left.TargetHost == $right.Computer
| where TxFCallCount >= 1
| extend TargetDevice = TargetHost, AccountName = Initiator, HostCustomEntity = TargetHost
| project
    TargetDevice,
    AccountName,
    RollbackTime,
    ProcCreateTime,
    RollbackProcessName,
    RollbackProcessPath,
    SuspiciousProcessName,
    SuspiciousCommandLine,
    ParentProcessName,
    TxFCallCount
| order by ProcCreateTime desc
